title: 💻 A Lightweight Laptop at a Surprising Price!
body: 💻 A Lightweight Laptop at a Surprising Price!
LG launched its new Gram Book 14 in the US starting at $799, with a special offer of $499 until the end of November.
The device weighs only about 1.3 kg, and its battery lasts up to 30.5 hours of video playback in tests.
Simply put, a light and powerful laptop that suits students and working from anywhere.
Does a laptop’s weight matter to you when buying? Or is battery life first?
